create_PauseFailControl: create a PauseFailControl instance to pause or fail code under test in a separate thread
use_PauseFailControl_pause: use the pause context manager to suspend execution of code calling control until the context exits
use_PauseFailControl_fail: use the fail context manager to raise a Defect exception in code calling control
use_PauseFailControl_block_until_paused: call block_until_paused to wait until the controlled code has entered the paused state
raise_Defect_exception: raise a Defect exception to simulate a programming defect in a system under test
